name: Phia Oac–Phia Den National Park
nameVi: Vườn quốc gia Phja Oắc – Phja Đén
kicker: Moss forest on a 1,935 m summit
summary: Drive up into the moss and elfin forest of Phia Oac, west of Cao Bang city. The national park covers 11,960 ha, and the summit on this road is 1,935 m. Give it a day of its own. Skip it when the falls are the only day you have. The gate fee and the drive time are check on arrival.
timeNeeded: A full day from the city
getThere: West from Cao Bang city. Drive minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Moss and cloud forest on Phia Oac

notice.title: This is not the waterfall day
notice.body: Phia Oac is west of the city. Ban Gioc is east, more than 80 km the other way. Putting them on the same afternoon drops one of them.

body: The park was set on 8 January 2014, on 11,960 ha, expanding the older Phia Oac forest in Nguyen Binh. The road climbs from evergreen forest into moss and elfin forest, 467.60 ha of that high forest, and the air cools as you go up.
The summit on this road is 1,935 m. The same day can include tea hills above 1,300 m, a red villa among pines, and Tran Hung Dao Forest. This day is forest and the ridge, not a second waterfall.
Give it a clear day, and give it the whole day. The gate fee, the hours, and the drive from the city are check on arrival. Storms on the mountain road are check on arrival too.

figures.caption: Karst ridges above Phia Den, on the western road
figures.alt: Forested karst peaks above a valley road in the Phia Oac–Phia Den reserve

gettingThere: Phia Oac is the western day, out of Cao Bang city toward Nguyen Binh and the park. Hire a car or a motorbike in the city. Drive minutes are check on arrival. Start early if you want the summit in daylight.

legs.heading: From Cao Bang city
legs.body: West by car or motorbike. Drive minutes are check on arrival. This is a full day, not a stop on the way to the falls.

closed: Check on arrival. Storm closures are check on arrival.
